source_cutoff.cutoff_reason: User approved analysis cutoff before 5 GB completion.

mechanisms.rule: Every claimed causal improvement must name an intervention, an observable outcome, a rival explanation, and a refutation condition.
mechanisms.studio_change: Add causal-hypothesis and counterfactual fields to every intervention packet; do not turn correlation into a systems claim.
mechanisms.gate: Plant an intervention whose observed outcome disagrees with the hypothesis; packet must turn RED rather than preserve the claim.

mechanisms.rule: When queue age rises, cap work-in-progress at the narrowest verified constraint before adding parallel agents or schedules.
mechanisms.studio_change: Every campaign, swarm, and scheduled workflow declares WIP cap, queue-age signal, and drain condition.
mechanisms.gate: Inject more queued units than the cap; system must defer excess work and report queue age instead of silently growing backlog.

mechanisms.rule: A controller may act only on state it can observe at the relevant delay; unknown state routes to bounded observation, never adaptive guessing.
mechanisms.studio_change: System maps specify observed state, observer, sampling delay, allowed controller action, and unknown-state escalation.
mechanisms.gate: Remove the required signal; controller must emit UNKNOWN/BLOCKED and avoid corrective action.

mechanisms.rule: A gate covers combinations of state, boundary, and failure mode—not merely a list of functions called.
mechanisms.studio_change: Every high-stakes verification matrix includes situation dimensions and at least one planted-failure case per guarded boundary.
mechanisms.gate: Plant a failure in an uncovered situation; coverage report must show a missing cell, then turn green only after a new regression case exists.

mechanisms.rule: High-impact actions cross a typed human approval boundary with a named approver, scope, expiry, and audit row.
mechanisms.studio_change: Extend Gate-D packets with approval owner, action class, scope, expiry, and denied-path receipt; approval routing is a system boundary, not a chat convention.
mechanisms.gate: Submit an action with a wrong/expired approver; it must fail before external execution and retain a denial receipt.

mechanisms.rule: Every unattended loop needs telemetry sufficient for the next operator to distinguish a failed dependency, an unknown state, and a completed action.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require health signal, last-success timestamp, last-failure evidence, queue/WIP age, and causal correlation ID in studio run packets.
mechanisms.gate: Suppress a required signal; diagnostic output must name the missing signal and degrade rather than report healthy.

mechanisms.rule: Intent, boundary, test, artifact, and acceptance evidence stay traceably linked across the system boundary.
mechanisms.studio_change: DoneContracts become traceability records: mission intent → hypothesis → intervention → gate → evidence → decision.
mechanisms.gate: Delete one link in the chain; verifier must reject the done claim as untraceable.

mechanisms.rule: Recovery is valid only when degraded state is visible, fallback activation is proven, and restoration is verified against the original contract.
mechanisms.studio_change: Replace binary healthy/dead reports with PASS, DEGRADED, REPAIR_ATTEMPTED, and BLOCKED; pair every fallback with a restore drill.
mechanisms.gate: Break the primary path; fallback must surface DEGRADED, preserve the evidence, and pass a restore check after recovery.

mechanisms.rule: For reversible but high-cost interventions, run a shadow model against live observations before changing the live controller.
mechanisms.studio_change: Add shadow-mode stage to systems changes: baseline → shadow prediction → divergence threshold → human decision → live rollout.
mechanisms.gate: Force shadow/live divergence beyond threshold; rollout must block and attach the divergence evidence.

mechanisms.rule: Automation changes are assessed against incentives, human override, ownership, and technical boundary behavior together.
mechanisms.studio_change: Every systems intervention packet names affected human roles, incentives changed, override route, and social failure signal.
mechanisms.gate: Remove the human owner or override route; approval must fail as incomplete boundary design.

mechanisms.rule: Classify the recurring behavior (constraint, shifting burden, limits-to-growth, feedback delay) before selecting a remedy.
mechanisms.studio_change: Gap reports include archetype hypothesis, evidence, expected recurrence, leverage point, and a counter-archetype test.
mechanisms.gate: Present a remedy without an archetype/evidence row; studio verifier returns NOT_READY.
